identification: Two boxes of about 60 mid-century hardbacks, mostly reprints in chipped jackets. Named titles: Milne When We Were Very Young and Now We Are Six (Methuen, Shepard jackets, spines show small jackets, probably 1940s-50s reprints), Heyer The Reluctant Widow (Heinemann), Nevil Shute Pastoral (Heinemann), How Green Was My Valley (Michael Joseph), C.J. Dennis Songs of a Sentimental Bloke (jacketed, edition unknown), Donn Byrne x3 (Sampson Low, no jackets), Quentin Reynolds, George Sava x4 (Faber), Axel Munthe San Michele, Philip Gibbs x2, Koran (World's Classics), Kilburn Tale, Song of Bernadette. Nothing seen that is a confirmed first edition. Value rests on the Milne pair and possibly Heyer/Shute/Bloke if early printings.

entries.note: Now We Are Six, Shepard decorations, probably an early (first/first-year) printing so better than the lot's likely reprint. Price list only, premium extra. Upper bound for the Milne pair.
Now We Are Six, plain copy with an unrelated inscription, no jacket mentioned. Premium extra. Better guide to a later printing.

viewing_check: Pull the two Milne books and check the copyright page (back of title page): printing line or date (1924/1927 firsts versus 1940s-50s reprints, e.g. 'Thirty-first edition'), jacket price on the spine, and whether jackets are original. Then check copyright pages of Heyer (1946 first versus later), Pastoral, How Green Was My Valley, the jacketed Sentimental Bloke (A&R printing number), and look for library marks or inscriptions. Read the two jacketless books at the bottom and the partly hidden titles in box 1.
